kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أدلهم (form IVq)
# أَدْلَهِمُّ (ʔadlahimmu) /ʔad.la.him.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# أَدْلَهِمَّ (ʔadlahimma) /ʔad.la.him.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# أَدْلَهِمِّ (ʔadlahimmi) /ʔad.la.him.mi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
